high_level_description: This image shows the exterior of a building with a signboard mounted on a white wall. The signboard reads "NMP Audit and Consulting Co., Ltd." in blue and black text. The wall appears to be part of an industrial or commercial structure, as there are visible cables and what looks like an electrical box above the sign.
